correctness.rationale: Subtracting the baseline j reduces stable tenth-power offsets to gaps of the semigroup generated by m^10-1. Every generator is proved to lie in <1023,59048,25937424600>, and the converse is immediate. A canonical residue decomposition over <93,5368> then gives the exact Frobenius number, genus, and symmetry. A standalone finite verifier independently reproduces the subsidiary two-generator calculations and final constants.

originality.rationale: Benfield--Lippard give only |B^10|>=129687123005 and state the relevant even-exponent symmetry conjectures. Searches for the exact constants, equivalent generator sets, numerical-semigroup formulations, and follow-up work found no exact exponent-10 determination. The unavailable Zenkin 1995 full text is recorded as residual risk, and no novelty is claimed for the general offset-semigroup lemma.

value.rationale: The result replaces a large published lower bound by an exact description of the entire stable obstruction set, computes its Frobenius number and genus, and proves the exponent-10 cases of two structural symmetry conjectures by a conceptual three-generator reduction.
